caption: On September 18, 2026, Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reported that Anthropic's own data shows Claude is leading 26% of the company's AI research and development. The figure came from Anthropic itself — not a third-party estimate. That same week, SoftBank disclosed nearly $21 billion in potential fresh borrowings to expand its AI financing capacity, and infrastructure company Crusoe closed roughly $4 billion in new funding, with CEO Chase Lochmiller speaking publicly about the race to build the compute layer powering frontier AI. Capital markets are pricing in a world where AI self-directed R&D is an operating assumption. One detail the source material leaves open is how Anthropic defines 'leading' a task — whether Claude is initiating research directions autonomously or executing on human-defined prompts at scale.
